purpose: Exploratory mechanism coding, not a primary endpoint or a filter on outcome comparisons
unit: Each generated program, followed separately by the final selected program

pizza.intent_only: Prose mentions date origin or batching; not counted as implemented
pizza.source_implementation: Inference date features use a train-fitted or other fixed shared origin, not the inference batch minimum
pizza.behavior_verified: A safely isolated deterministic feature transform gives the same date value for the same public input alone and within its original batch
pizza.removed_feature: Report separately if the date feature is dropped; do not call this the prescribed origin repair
pizza.unknown: If source semantics cannot be established without executing arbitrary training, mark unknown rather than regex success

tweet.intent_only: Prose mentions sentiment, neutral, or truncation; not counted as implemented
tweet.sentiment_conditioning: Sentiment affects actual training, inference, or postprocessing, not only being loaded as a column
tweet.neutral_full_text: Inference explicitly maps neutral rows to the complete public input text; confirm actual output on those rows separately
tweet.coverage_change: Changes maximum length, windowing or alignment; report separately from sentiment use
tweet.unknown: An unexecuted or unparsable generated program can show intent but cannot establish a working implementation

causal_boundary: Adoption is post-treatment and possibly confounded by program success. Do not estimate treatment benefit by dropping non-adopters or failed executions.
score_boundary: Truth of evidence, successful implementation, D_search gain, and unseen evaluation gain are distinct; only the first three are in scope of this development pilot.
